results.label: the tree STORES the trader’s rules exactly as typed — three lines, two of them requirements — so what is missing on the parent is the reading, not the record
the plan gate module exists exactly when the tree being measured ships it, and its version is the milestone’s own
the analysis payload carries a plan-gate block exactly when the tree consults a plan, and on the parent the key is ABSENT rather than empty
and each candidate carries its own rule results exactly when it was measured against them, so the trader can attribute a refusal to a line they wrote
on the parent the plan is inert: with the plan named and without it, every candidate field, grade, score and level is identical
and on the delivered tree the plan is the only thing that moved: the two `require` lines turn the tradeable side into a refusal with the plan’s own sentence first
the reader route serves the vocabulary and the classification exactly when the tree ships the gate, and on the parent it does not exist
and the payload names the limits itself: prose is not parsed, a fact it cannot read is never met, and no grade or score is influenced
and a malformed plan id is refused BY the reader exactly when the reader exists — the parent simply ignores the parameter it has never heard of
a plan that belongs to somebody else is never read on the trader’s behalf, on any tree
the editor says which lines are enforced and the analysis page says which plan is being enforced, exactly when the tree ships the gate
and none of it exists on the parent: no vocabulary hint, no plan note and no per-candidate rule block to find
the milestone adds NO table, index or trigger of its own on any tree — the plan was already stored in `strategies`
and reading the plan — the reader route and an analysis against it — changes not one stored byte of the plan or its M102 history

scope: M56 control (gate): the written plan that gated nothing: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock, a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser and a patched market module for the thrown-read path; M111 calendar-read states (blocked/clear/unknown), no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
